rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to say that someone has been made to lose face or feel ashamed.

example.english: You really humiliate him by scolding him in front of so many people.
example.traditional: 你咁樣當住咁多人鬧佢，真係搞到佢冇面。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 dong1 zyu6 gam3 do1 jan4 naau6 keoi5 zan1 hai6 gaau2 dou3 keoi5 mou5 min2

rows.note: Use this when the humiliation involves making A look foolish, especially in front of other people.

example.english: You humiliate me by calling the wrong name on stage.
example.traditional: 你喺台上叫錯人個名，搞到我出醜。
example.jyutping: nei5 hai2 toi1 soeng6 giu3 co3 jan4 go3 ming4 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 ceot1 cau2

rows.note: Use this for a more serious or explicit attack on someone's dignity, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: To humiliate someone in public like that is simply too much.
example.traditional: 當眾咁樣侮辱人，實在太過分。
example.jyutping: dong1 zung3 gam3 joeng2 mou5 juk6 jan4 sat6 zoi6 taai3 gwo3 fan6
